people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gershon
people.line: Firstborn son of Levi; head of the Gershonite Levites.

people.name: Kohath
people.line: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translations.bsb: Then David divided the Levites into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
translations.kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translations.asv: And David divided them into courses according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
